facts.text: Maria recently gave talks at a homeless shelter where she volunteers and received compliments from other volunteers.

evidence.quote: I recently gave a few talks at the homeless shelter I volunteer at. It was really fulfilling and I received lots of compliments from other volunteers.

facts.text: Maria bought a cross necklace to feel closer to her faith, which has made her happy.

evidence.quote: And, I bought a cross necklace to feel closer to my faith- which has made me happy.

facts.text: Maria feels that connecting with and helping others brings her joy and makes a real difference.

evidence.quote: It was a great reminder about why connecting with and helping others is so important.
It's so great to make a real difference. Seeing the impact and hearing the gratitude fills me with so much joy.

facts.text: Maria feels that the people at the homeless shelter have become like family to her and that she is blessed to know them.

evidence.quote: The people at the shelter have become like family to me. I feel really blessed to know them.
